verdict.rationale: Lever documents in-app custom dashboards that can be built, templatized and shared, and a developer API with list endpoints (applications, deleted applications, audit events) plus webhooks that could feed a warehouse through custom engineering. Nothing in the evidence shows a purpose-built reporting/export path, so getting data out relies on self-built pipelines. Missing for 10: scheduled exports, BI connectors, a dedicated reporting/analytics API or warehouse sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
